-- Pipeline-health view surfaced to BI. One row per admission_date with
-- counts of encounters, clinical events, and the quality flags that
-- fct_encounter_operations already tracks. Keeps the "is the pipeline
-- healthy?" question answerable with a single tile, independent of the
-- clinical or financial dashboards.

with encounters as (
    select
        admission_date,
        count(*) as encounter_count,
        sum(event_count) as clinical_event_count,
        sum(events_missing_timestamp) as events_missing_timestamp,
        sum(events_missing_department) as events_missing_department,
        sum(events_arriving_over_24h_late) as events_arriving_over_24h_late,
        sum(denied_claim_count) as denied_claim_count
    from `healthcare-intelligence-512118`.`healthcare_capstone_analytics`.`fct_encounter_operations`
    group by admission_date
),

ingest_runs as (
    select
        date(started_at) as run_date,
        count(*) as ingest_run_count,
        countif(lower(status) = 'success') as ingest_run_success_count,
        countif(lower(status) != 'success') as ingest_run_failure_count,
        max(started_at) as last_ingest_run_at
    from `healthcare-intelligence-512118`.`healthcare_capstone_raw`.`_ingestion_runs`
    group by run_date
)

select
    coalesce(e.admission_date, i.run_date) as reporting_date,

    -- Volume
    e.encounter_count,
    e.clinical_event_count,

    -- Quality flags from the fact
    e.events_missing_timestamp,
    e.events_missing_department,
    e.events_arriving_over_24h_late,
    e.denied_claim_count,

    -- Flag rates (null-safe)
    safe_divide(e.events_missing_timestamp, e.clinical_event_count) as events_missing_timestamp_rate,
    safe_divide(e.events_missing_department, e.clinical_event_count) as events_missing_department_rate,
    safe_divide(e.events_arriving_over_24h_late, e.clinical_event_count) as events_arriving_over_24h_late_rate,

    -- Ingestion-run audit
    i.ingest_run_count,
    i.ingest_run_success_count,
    i.ingest_run_failure_count,
    i.last_ingest_run_at

from encounters e
full outer join ingest_runs i on e.admission_date = i.run_date
order by reporting_date desc

-- One row per encounter with operational facts, patient dimensions,
-- and ML scores joined in. Powers encounter-level dashboards and
-- lets BI users filter by predicted risk alongside real outcomes.
-- Readmission and LOS scores only exist for encounters in the
-- held-out test fold, so the left joins are expected to be sparse.

with encounters as (
    select * from `healthcare-intelligence-512118`.`healthcare_capstone_analytics`.`fct_encounter_operations`
),

patients as (
    select * from `healthcare-intelligence-512118`.`healthcare_capstone_analytics`.`dim_patient`
),

readmission_scores as (
    select
        encounter_id,
        readmission_probability,
        model_name as readmission_model_name,
        scored_at as readmission_scored_at
    from `healthcare-intelligence-512118`.`healthcare_capstone_ml`.`ml_readmission_predictions`
),

los_scores as (
    select
        encounter_id,
        length_of_stay_hours_predicted,
        model_name as length_of_stay_model_name,
        scored_at as length_of_stay_scored_at
    from `healthcare-intelligence-512118`.`healthcare_capstone_ml`.`ml_length_of_stay_predictions`
)

select
    e.encounter_id,
    e.patient_id,
    e.facility_id,
    e.admission_ts,
    e.admission_date,
    e.discharge_ts,
    e.service_line,
    e.primary_diagnosis_group,
    e.payer,
    e.discharge_disposition,

    -- Patient context
    p.sex,
    p.home_state,
    p.birth_year,
    extract(year from e.admission_ts) - p.birth_year as patient_age_at_admission,

    -- Operational facts
    e.length_of_stay_hours,
    e.event_count,
    e.events_missing_timestamp,
    e.events_missing_department,
    e.events_arriving_over_24h_late,

    -- Financials
    e.billed_amount,
    e.allowed_amount,
    e.paid_amount,
    e.denied_claim_count,

    -- Outcomes
    e.readmitted_30d,

    -- ML scores (null for encounters outside the test fold)
    r.readmission_probability,
    r.readmission_model_name,
    r.readmission_scored_at,
    l.length_of_stay_hours_predicted,
    l.length_of_stay_model_name,
    l.length_of_stay_scored_at,

    -- Derived error metric when both actual and predicted LOS are present
    case
        when l.length_of_stay_hours_predicted is not null
             and e.length_of_stay_hours is not null
        then l.length_of_stay_hours_predicted - e.length_of_stay_hours
    end as length_of_stay_prediction_error_hours

from encounters e
left join patients p on e.patient_id = p.patient_id
left join readmission_scores r on e.encounter_id = r.encounter_id
left join los_scores l on e.encounter_id = l.encounter_id

-- Daily rollup per facility and service line. Each row is one
-- (admission_date, facility_id, service_line) grouping and summarizes
-- throughput, length of stay (actual and predicted), readmission risk,
-- and pipeline data-quality flags. ML averages only reflect encounters
-- that fell in the held-out test fold, so counts are reported alongside.

with scorecard as (
    select * from `healthcare-intelligence-512118`.`healthcare_capstone_analytics`.`rpt_encounter_risk_scorecard`
)

select
    admission_date,
    facility_id,
    service_line,

    -- Throughput
    count(*) as encounter_count,
    count(distinct patient_id) as distinct_patient_count,
    sum(case when readmitted_30d then 1 else 0 end) as readmitted_30d_count,
    safe_divide(
        sum(case when readmitted_30d then 1 else 0 end),
        count(*)
    ) as readmitted_30d_rate,

    -- Length of stay (actual)
    avg(length_of_stay_hours) as length_of_stay_hours_avg,
    approx_quantiles(length_of_stay_hours, 100)[offset(50)] as length_of_stay_hours_median,
    approx_quantiles(length_of_stay_hours, 100)[offset(90)] as length_of_stay_hours_p90,

    -- ML coverage and averages (null-safe)
    countif(readmission_probability is not null) as scored_readmission_encounter_count,
    avg(readmission_probability) as readmission_probability_avg,
    countif(length_of_stay_hours_predicted is not null) as scored_length_of_stay_encounter_count,
    avg(length_of_stay_hours_predicted) as length_of_stay_hours_predicted_avg,
    avg(abs(length_of_stay_prediction_error_hours)) as length_of_stay_mae_hours,

    -- Financials
    sum(billed_amount) as billed_amount_total,
    sum(paid_amount) as paid_amount_total,
    sum(denied_claim_count) as denied_claim_count_total,

    -- Pipeline data-quality flags
    sum(events_missing_timestamp) as events_missing_timestamp_total,
    sum(events_missing_department) as events_missing_department_total,
    sum(events_arriving_over_24h_late) as events_arriving_over_24h_late_total

from scorecard
group by 1, 2, 3
